what: An 80px white dot at the center of the section, when the section top reaches the 2/3 point up the screen, spreads once over 1s ease into a large ellipse 160vw wide (280vw on phones) by the section height, becoming a white stage. The content above it rises from 40px below in .4s. The section’s top and bottom ends remain as rounded arcs, so white islands appear between the paper-background sections. It is not tied to scroll and spreads all at once (the scroll-tied one is circle-spread-scrub).

options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Spread point (dot) — laid behind the section
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top 66.667% (original: scroll + viewport height/1.5 ≥ section top edge)
options.rise · rise-dur: Distance (px) and duration (seconds) for content to float up, default 40 · .4

note: The original measures position on every scroll, adds is-animated, and lets a CSS transition (width·height 1s ease) spread it. Sections already visible on the first screen do not spread before the first scroll in the original either, but the part measures as soon as it is attached.

from.where: index.html .solution__each (white stage where ‹logo + four services› rises in below the concerns section)
